name: insight-agent-platform
description: 企业经营分析与决策 Agent 平台。

scripts.dev:backend: cd services/agent-runtime && uv run uvicorn src.app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.help:scripts:
node -e "console.log('dev: 启动前端
dev:web: 启动前端
dev:web:open: 启动前端并打开浏览器
dev:backend: 启动 FastAPI 后端
debug:web: 打开前端页面
debug:api: 打开 FastAPI Swagger Docs
debug:health: 请求 /health
verify: 结构和格式检查')"
scripts.verify: pnpm check:structure && pnpm check:contracts && pnpm format:check
scripts.lint:backend: cd services/agent-runtime && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format:backend: cd services/agent-runtime && uv run ruff format .
scripts.typecheck:backend: cd services/agent-runtime && uv run mypy src tests
